claim_scope: Repository-disjoint development qualification; not final test or leaderboard evidence.

hypothesis.problem: Explicit goal state preserves unresolved findings but a strong model can still repeat operations whose relevance and evidence basis are implicit.
hypothesis.mechanism: Require each open Bash candidate to bind its new repair to current finding IDs, model-visible precondition evidence, an expected finding delta, and an open operation-family identity; reject conclusively failed exact scripts and same-family retries without newly cited evidence.
hypothesis.primary: The operation-relevance contract improves or preserves Official Pass relative to the frozen fresh evidence-anchor control.
hypothesis.secondary: After a first executable-goal failure, the contract reduces evidence-free repeated repairs and improves progress calibration without increasing Unknown or policy-output failure enough to reduce terminal reach.

provider_gate.proceed_rule: All three provider responses parse into valid operation-contract candidates, finish normally, and produce no request or policy error.
provider_gate.failure_rule: Repair only provider/output compatibility without opening or selecting a repository identity; update the algorithm freeze if prompt or parser semantics change.

shared_contract.token_policy: Tokens and price are reported outcomes; configured limits are emergency guards, not research stopping thresholds.

mechanism_metrics: contract proposal and rejection counts by reason
expected finding deltas met, not met, or unknown
descriptive_metrics: input, cached, output, and reasoning tokens
logical model requests and provider attempts
candidate environments, commands, and wall-clock time
integrity_gate: Every treatment candidate carries a valid versioned operation contract.
Every referenced target and precondition evidence ID appeared in that candidate's model input.
Only complete same-goal snapshots claim finding resolution.
The treatment and control differ only in the frozen operation-contract mechanism and isolated launcher.
No Official evaluator finding enters an online model input or state transition.
Every terminal Official result uses an identity-matched fresh environment and passes repository integrity.
analysis.proceed_rule: Retain v1 for larger qualification if the integrity gate passes, Official Pass does not regress, and at least one repository exhibits either a treatment-only Official repair or a correctly calibrated suppression that prevents an evidence-free repeated execution.
analysis.failure_rule: If integrity fails, repair measurement before interpretation. If effectiveness or mechanism gates fail, archive all selected repositories as consumed and redesign only from internal trajectories before selecting another batch.
analysis.infrastructure_retry_policy: Retry only a preregistered infrastructure-censored episode with identical code, settings, seed, and case; never replace a case based on outcome.
